title: Support for Job Redesign and platform workers returning to traditional employment
asked: Mr Gerald Giam asked whether the Support for Job Redesign programme is used to incentivise flexible work arrangements that mirror platform autonomy to attract platform workers back to traditional employment, and what results the programme has achieved.
response: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong said the Support for Job Redesign programme helps employers redesign jobs to drive business objectives, including accommodating flexible work arrangements, improve workforce effectiveness and tap a broader pool of workers. He said it is not targeted at bringing platform workers back to traditional employment, because platform workers operate under different work arrangements from employees on FWAs, and Workforce Singapore does not track how many platform workers transition to traditional employment through the programme. In supplementary replies, he said platform workers may choose platform work for flexibility or control, and that for those who wish to transit out, the Government provides resources such as e2i career matching services, Career Conversion Programmes, the Mid-career Pathway Programme and SkillsFuture Transition Programmes.
